tagline: 禄来胶片单反相机，1968 年发布
description: 禄来于1968年推出的胶片单反相机。配备Zeiss Tessar 2.8, 40mm (supplied)。快门速度Compur leaf 1/2 sec. - 1/500 sec. plus bulb。使用126 film cartridge。

specs.快门: Compur leaf 1/2 sec. - 1/500 sec. plus bulb
specs.取景器: includes split-image rangefinder and exposure indicator
specs.英文简介: The Rolleiflex SL26 is a manual-exposure SLR camera for Kodak's 126 film.
